intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours to the platinum (PowerPyx). No multiplayer, no DLC, no online trophies — everything is single-player. There is no mission replay (GTA Scoop), so play the story straight through, and never turn cheats on: guides report cheats disable trophies and saving. After the finale, free roam continues and the 100% checklist appears (Push Square) — most of the hunt happens there.
note_missable: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. One meditation spot sits at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and may not be reachable later (PowerPyx / GTABase). Meditate there before you finish Chapter 1. Everything else can be earned in free roam after the story.

stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–4 and the finale
stages.what: Play every story mission in order. This earns all 12 story trophies (the opening mission, the four chapter completions, the six named missions and the finale gold) and opens the map. In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house — the one possibly missable spot. Between missions, try one of each activity type and start the stranger strands you pass.

stages.title: Side strands — contacts and strangers
stages.what: Finish the five named contact chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — one trophy each) and 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida (silver). Strangers are found by exploring, so this stage overlaps with exploring all 52 areas.

stages.title: Activities and skill
stages.what: Try all 9 activity types (Master of None), then grind the big ones: gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist), win drone races at all 14 locations (Top Fun), win 20 different races, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, bowl at Kolt & Associates, and complete 50 of the 80 challenges (One Last Thing). Cunning Stunts needs any 250 of the 397 stunts.

stages.title: Collectibles and exploration
stages.what: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, explore all 52 areas, discover 100 vehicles, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, spend $100,000 in shops, and let the 500 Criminal Profile actions accumulate. Do this in free roam with the in-game checklist open.

stages.title: Crime and robberies
stages.what: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (silver), rob an armored truck and escape, rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs, rob a jewelry store undetected, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, and land the melee drive-by. Save a clean getaway vehicle before every robbery.

stages.title: 100% completion and the platinum
stages.what: Open Progress > Stats after the story: the 100% checklist has 35 requirements (The Gamers Hub). Finish them and A Long Road (gold) pops — and with it, Vice Got a Price!, the platinum. Check the checklist, not your memory, for what is left.
